title: Installment Terms Clause: Monthly Installment of a Testing Supplies Payment Plan
content:
**Clause.** On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, a payment plan covers the program's balance; the installments number the tier's most monthly installments figure; the monthly installment is the covered balance divided by the number of installments and rounded to cents, never below the tier's smallest monthly installment and never more than the covered balance; the number of installments is never more than the tier's most monthly installments figure and never fewer than 1. Where no plan is offered, no installment is fixed.

Stated as one quantity: the monthly installment is the lower of the covered balance and the higher of the rounded quotient and the smallest monthly installment.

**Combination.** Any rule that replaces or changes a quantity of this plan does so only for the quantity it names; replacements come before installments are added or taken off, and the limits above apply after all of them.

The program's balance is the running total of its remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds, less its payments and balance adjustments.

**Worked installments (hypothetical balances)**

| Tier figures | Covered balance | Installments | Rounded quotient | Monthly installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| most installments 6, smallest installment 25.00 | 480.00 | 6 | 80.00 | 80.00 |
| most installments 10, smallest installment 20.00 | 150.00 | 10 | 15.00 | 20.00 |
| most installments 10, smallest installment 20.00 | 1000.00 | 10 | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| most installments 6, smallest installment 25.00 | 100.00 | 6 | 16.67 | 25.00 |

Rounding to cents comes before the comparison with the smallest installment: 100.00 divided by 6 is 16.666…, rounded to 16.67, and then raised to 25.00.
